executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $321.66 per resident day (46.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -46.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $3,163,145, 28.5% of the $11,082,054 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,561,257, $45.32 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $742,285 (47.5%), allocated fringe $215,493 (13.8%), non-wage costs $603,479 (38.7%). Raw food was $545,791 ($15.84 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $39,241.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $688,566, $19.99 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $468,710 (68.1%), allocated fringe $136,072 (19.8%), non-wage costs $83,784 (12.2%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $129,573, $3.76 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $97,390 (75.2%), allocated fringe $28,273 (21.8%), non-wage costs $3,910 (3.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
